newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy kerosene for July delivery.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy kerosene for July delivery.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy superior kerosene for delivery in July, an industry source said on Thursday.
The tender seeks 40,000-to-45,000-tonne cargoes for delivery to Madras or Haldia on the Indian east coast, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis.
The tender closes on June 5 and offers will be valid until June 6, he said.
IOC cancelled its previous tender to buy kerosene for June delivery.
In its tender for May deliveries, IOC puchased 90,000 tonnes of kerosene in two cargoes.
The first cargo for May was awarded to trader BB Energy at a premium of $34.84 per tonne to Mediterranean spot quotes, c-and-f east coast, while the second cargo was sold by Shell at the same price.
India bought one cargo for April.

Earlier this month, IOC awarded a one-year term tender to supply 30,000 tonnes per month of kerosene to Kuwait Petroleum Corp for delivery to the Indian west coast at $1.32 per barrel above MidEast spot quotes, c-and-f basis.
